speaker: abel_garnish
text: The boxes are down. I am not going to make them into a poem. They hold eleven pound six. That is the whole of the sentence, and I will not divide it to flatter a stair.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Citizens, their wives, clerks come before their masters, and half the Bankside. I never carried my box down so heavy, nor a yard so quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A quiet yard is a strange thanks. I will take it. I will not ask you what your stair weighed apart from the rest. The rest is the number Abel has, and one number is enough.

speaker: margery_pell
text: I have no second number, Master Shakespeare. I have a heavy box and a yard that forgot to crack nuts, which is as near a sermon as I ever mean to preach. I am setting the box down. I am not staying to discuss the fourth act.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The quiet held under the jig as well, for a minute, which is a minute a tune does not usually get. Then Kemp took it, and the minute ended honestly.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I danced it like a man owed money, if that is the look you all insist on naming. The beat was there. I did not write the beat. Sweet Master Shakespeare filled the house, and I emptied my legs, and between us the afternoon occurred.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You owed the jig nothing and paid it anyway. There is no roll for you in the king. There was a dance after. That was the bargain, and you kept it in front of a yard that had gone still enough to notice.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Still is your trick, not mine. I am glad of it when it makes the noise afterwards louder. I am not glad of it as a diet. Do not ask me to be quiet for a living. I should starve, and the starvation would be loud.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The gown held, sir. And the grain held. Nobody laughed at either, which I was half ready for, and half ashamed of being ready for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody was going to laugh at thee. Thou wert exact. Exact is not a joke, whatever the yard does with gardeners.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The garden got its laugh from the hired men, and from nowhere else that I could hear. I did not build on it. A laugh is not an invitation to restore a parliament.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And no one restored one. The plot was the plot. I will say that once, because once is how a book-keeper praises, and then I will go back to eleven pound six, which does not grow by being repeated.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Repeated or not, it was a full house that listened. I do not know what the other house did today. I was not there, and I do not want a rumour standing in for a sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. Their title promised a disguise. Ours promised an ending. The town came north. That is what I saw. I did not see a figure on the other bank, and I will not have one handed to me as conversation.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then I will not hand you one. Half the Bankside was on my stair, and the other half may do as it likes over the water. My box is down. My arm is my own again. Good afternoon to all of you who still want to talk about a play that is over.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: It is over, and the Queen is off. I will not discuss the doublet, sir, if that was to be the next kindness. The grain was the work. The doublet was cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The doublet was cloth. Thou mayst go. Thou wert the still part of a loud afternoon, and the still part held.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. That is Dick, done with words, which in him is a kindness so large I hardly know where to put my hat. I will put it on my head and go, before I spend the kindness.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Go. The eleven pound six will be here in the morning in the form of a memory, and on Saturday in the form of a share, and the share is not this conversation. I am not paying anyone out of a Thursday box on a Thursday stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No one is asking to be paid out of it. I have not got a jest for eleven pound six. I have a jaw, and a door I stood at, and a line that landed. That will have to be the thanks.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: It is enough thanks for a tune. I am going to put the lute where Kemp cannot borrow it. God keep you, Will. The quiet was real. I do not say that often, and I am not going to decorate it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: And I have said my line. The yard was quiet and the box was heavy, and I am not staying to polish either. Good night to the poet. The stairs are that way, and they are suddenly lighter.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Eleven pound six, and I am saying it once more only so nobody carries a different figure home. I will not say it a third time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once more is enough. I heard it the first time, and the first time was the one I will keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night, Margery. I will write it as you said it. Abel, leave the number whole. Dick has the right of it. There is nothing to add that would not make the afternoon smaller.
